candidates.speaker: client
candidates.text:
Thank you for the feedback!
Our current website for the Bay Area locations, San Francisco CA and Fairfield CA, is [URL_001].
For bookings, WE USE WIX.
We are opening an additional location in Seattle WA, and it will open under the name Smash Room because our brand will be Smash Room from now on. We therefore want [URL_002] to serve as our master site, bringing our brand, locations, and information together in one place. It should include sublinks for each location while enabling every location to track its own bookings, revenue, and sales separately.

candidates.speaker: client
candidates.text:
I would like to create smash [URL_003] from scratch while using the same general type of template. We are beginning to franchise, so we need to be able to integrate new locations while still giving them full control.
We really like the layout of one of our competitors. It is simple, displays each location, and is easy to navigate.

candidates.speaker: client
candidates.text: Yes, that’s right. My main concern is that changing the branding, upgrading, and changing the website could hurt my bay area smash room SEO. What can we do to minimize that damage?

candidates.speaker: client
candidates.text: Yes. I also want to ensure the Seattle and Bay Area smash room operations remain separate, with each location having its own payouts, calendar, and revenue tracking.

candidates.speaker: client
candidates.text: But we’re essentially building one website format to use across every site. We would copy and paste it, changing only the branding and wording, while keeping all packages and prices unchanged.

candidates.speaker: client
candidates.text: The main site wouldn’t require a booking system because its sibling sites would handle the bookings.

candidates.speaker: client
candidates.text:
Hey! Here is the vision I have for the website.

The objective is to create a national brand website for SMASH ROOM that can accommodate multiple locations and support future franchise growth.

Primary Website:
[URL_006]

I would like a clean, modern, mobile-friendly design with simplicity comparable to iSmashUSA. The branding should use black, purple, and white, with large images, generous spacing, and straightforward navigation.

Sections for the Homepage:

Hero Banner
Location Selector
Rage Rooms
Axe Throwing
Splatter Room
Corporate Events
Birthday Parties
Reviews
FAQ
Contact

The homepage needs to show visitors our offerings right away and let them choose their location.

Locations at Present:

Fairfield, CA
San Francisco, CA
Seattle, WA

Every location should have a dedicated page of its own, while the design and branding remain consistent across all locations.

The site should be structured so that future locations can be added easily without requiring a redesign.

Possible future examples:

Phoenix
Denver
Austin
Franchise Locations

Overall, it should feel like a national entertainment brand rather than a local business website.

candidates.speaker: client
candidates.text:
Seattle must use a standalone Wix account and remain entirely separate from Bay Area Smash Room.

Seattle must have separate:

Bookings
Customer database
Analytics
Memberships
Gift cards
Payment processing
Staff access
Payouts

Customers should experience it as the same SMASH ROOM brand, while all backend operations remain completely independent.

Initially, Seattle should be presented as a “Coming Soon” location.

The Seattle page must follow this layout:

Hero Banner
Rage Rooms
Axe Throwing
Splatter Room
Corporate Events
Birthday Parties
FAQ
Photo Gallery
Contact Information
VIP Email Signup

The buttons should be:

Join VIP List
Opening Soon

Design the page so that when Seattle opens, booking only needs to be enabled and the photos updated, with no page redesign required.

Use the Seattle page as the template for future locations.
